basics.name: Minghai Wang
basics.label: iOS Engineer
basics.summary: Nearly 10 years of iOS development experience, responsible for delivering and iterating IoT, mobility, and AI products, with a strong focus on performance and stability.

projects.name: Seekee
projects.description: An AI browser for Latin America (Mexico, Brazil) and Turkey, integrating search, creation, and multimedia experiences.
duties: Owned the architecture and UX delivery of the Super Search module (intent recognition, voice search, text-to-image/image-to-image, translation, and document parsing), bridging cloud AI capabilities to on-device interaction flows.
highlights: Built a unified Super Search entry with SwiftUI + Combine, and split state/business logic using a TCA feature-based approach to improve extensibility, testability, and maintainability.
Evaluated multiple Markdown libraries for streaming output support and rendering behavior, selected swift-markdown-ui, and optimized AI summary streaming UX with SSE.
Led interaction refinements on the search results page, covering skeleton states, task-level loading/error states, and improving image-generation progress algorithms and animations.

projects.name: Honda RoadSync
projects.description: Honda RoadSync is a smart mobility app launched by Honda to support its motorcycle lineup, providing convenient and safe digital services for riders. Via Bluetooth connection between phone and motorcycle, users can operate navigation, calls, music playback, and notifications while staying focused on riding.
duties: Led localization delivery of Honda RoadSync as the technical PM and handed over to Honda Japan R&D.
highlights: Used classic Bluetooth to integrate cluster features like navigation, VoIP, music, volume, and weather; supported handlebar four-way switch control and voice prompts.
Built with SwiftUI and Combine; used Redux for state management and event dispatch.

projects.name: Smart Living & Smart Mobility OEM Suite
projects.description: Tuya provides one-stop OEM app building and management. Based on official templates, OEM apps offer easy UI customization and allow clients to configure brand settings.
duties: Iterated on Smart Living OEM features, maintaining home/member management, device/room lists, pairing, and message center.
Independently led Smart Mobility OEM iterations, including BLE+X device control, geofencing, third-party map navigation, passive unlocking, and Siri control.
highlights: OEM development model with configuration files; apps generated on demand after IoT platform configuration, with code pruning support.
Supported multiple pairing methods: EZ (Wi-Fi quick connect), AP (hotspot), NB-IoT, Bluetooth, QR code, etc.
Delivered an SDK that digitizes physical entities via a Thing Model, abstracting device instances with attributes, action events, and services, using MQTT for control and state monitoring.
Wide protocol support: Matter, Zigbee, BLE, Sigmesh, Beacon, Cat.1, etc.
Enabled Tuya devices for Home Assistant so users can control Tuya IoT devices within Home Assistant.

work.company: Renren Video (Moli (Shanghai) Information Technology Co., Ltd.)

highlights: Role: Responsible for iOS development and maintenance of the subsidiary product, Seekee AI Browser.

highlights: Role: Passenger app designated driver line, Project Dawn (internal) and DoraemonKit (open source) backend.

highlights: Role: Market business group, Finance Master (enterprise) client, and UI automation testing.
